hub.speaker: Eloise
hub.text: Sit. Tea first. Then we'll talk about whatever brought you all this way.

text_variants.text: The craft listens better once the birds stop. Sit. Tea's still tea in the dark.
You want the blight gone. I want what I'm owed. One of these is easy. Sit. Tea first. The craft has MANNERS.
Paid, one way or another. I don't ask which. Sit if you like, or don't — I've got stock for coin now too, if that suits you better than favors.
Mind the kettle, apprentice-of-no-one. The craft heard you. What it does about it is between you and your sleep.

options.text: Let's not make this ugly. I'll broker fair terms. [Calming Touch]
What have you got, for coin instead of favors?
I've got a few things I don't need, myself. Buying?
The way you work — the craft. Could a person learn it?

options._comment: Spec 4 (Task 6.2) RIVERFARM CAPSTONE. Lives on the HUB, not a chain tail, so a save whose price_of_a_favor is already reported still reaches it on any revisit (spec 8, old-save clause). Gated on the quest TERMINAL (price_of_a_favor_reported) rather than blight_lifted, matching Hedault's brothers_job_done and the forge arm's elevator_pass_stamped -- one rule for all three stops. Deliberately NOT excluded on drove_off_collectors: the force path banks the same terminal and Eloise is never removed from the hollow, so gating her out there would strand lattice_witch_lore and make the spine unfinishable for fight players.
options.text: You've been sniffing at me since I came in. Go on.

witch_ward_lore.speaker: Eloise
witch_ward_lore.text: Your door smells of a feeding ward. I keep one myself — smaller. Sit. If you're going to live over one, you'll learn what it eats.

witch_ward_taught._comment: HER OWN PIECE ONLY (spec 4): a hedge witch's feeding practice, scaled to her hollow. No seal, no lattice, no assembled picture -- she has never been under Liscor.
witch_ward_taught.speaker: Eloise
witch_ward_taught.text: Mine takes milk and a word, every seventh night. Small appetite, small keeping. Yours was built to hold something that argues back, and a ward like that gets fed on purpose, by someone who meant it to outlast them. Don't starve it in a hurry, child. A hungry ward goes looking.

truth.speaker: Eloise
truth.text: No blight. A bargain, unpaid. Someone in that village asked me for a favor and got exactly what they asked for. The price was always the second half of the deal, and they're pretending they forgot that part. The craft doesn't forget. It collects.

mediate_pitch.speaker: Eloise
mediate_pitch.text: Broker. That's a word for it. Go on, then, make your pitch. I'm not unreasonable. I'm owed, which isn't the same thing.

options.text: Take a year of hearth-tending instead of whatever you were owed.

mediate_argue.speaker: Eloise
mediate_argue.text: A year, tending my hearth. Not nothing, and not the debt I was owed either.

mediated.speaker: Eloise
mediated.text: Fine. Tea first, and then it's settled — a year's honest work is worth more to me than a favor nobody meant to keep.

shop.speaker: Eloise
shop.text: Coin, then. Fine — not everyone wants to owe me something bigger. Take what you need and go.

options.text: The herb sachet, sewn shut. (6 gold)
That warded bead you're not selling. (16 gold)
The travel-stone, under the cloth. (18 gold)
That pinch of warding salt, for the threshold.
That dark red draught, for the road. (10 gold)

bought.speaker: Eloise
bought.text: Sold. Don't come back asking for a refund because it didn't work the way you hoped. Nothing ever works the way anyone hopes.

stone_sold.speaker: Eloise
stone_sold.text: Distance is just another kindness, if you carry the right stone. This one already knows the road to Invrisil. Don't lose it before you get there.

witch_ask.speaker: Eloise
witch_ask.text: Anyone can learn the shape of it. Hats, herbs, words said over water. The craft itself asks one question first, and it isn't 'are you clever.'

witch_lesson._comment: The bank option is the spent one (hide_when witch_lessons); the ask path stays replayable as flavor. Gate shape: requires blight_lifted + hide_when drove_off_collectors on the hub option = the ratified peaceful-OR-path exactly (mediated OR paid), single-key hide_when because _meets_hide_when is AND-semantics (dialogue.gd:128).
witch_lesson.speaker: Eloise
witch_lesson.text: Why did the debt get paid, child? Not how — why. You sat at my table and went looking for the ending where nobody bled. That's the question, answered before I asked it. The craft roots in what a person already is. Mine roots in kindness. Yours will tell you its name when it's ready.

options.text: Then teach me the first of it.
I need to think on that.

witch_taught.speaker: Eloise
witch_taught.text: Small things first. A remedy that means it — stir like you're sorry for the sick, not proud of the pot. My cauldron is yours when the fire's lit, and the inn's kettle will do in a pinch. Sleep on it, child. The craft does its accounting at rest.
